newsitem.title: USA: John Kennedy Jr marries girlfriend - TV report.
newsitem.headline: John Kennedy Jr marries girlfriend - TV report.

text.p: John Kennedy Jr. married his girlfriend Carolyn Bessette on Cumberland Island off the Georgia coast on Saturday, a television station reported on Sunday.

Citing sources on the island, WTLV, an NBC affiliate in Jacksonville, Florida, reported that Kennedy and Bessette had exchanged vows at a chapel and celebrated the event at a "huge" private party under tents.

The station reported that the Grayfield Inn, where it said the Kennedys were staying, would not confirm the story, but the manager of a restaurant that catered the event said her staff told her that Kennedy and Bessette were married.
The television station also reported that Sen. Edward Kennedy of Massachusetts flew to nearby Fernandina Beach early on Saturday.
